name: WE TRUST
summary: This EA is a trend-following trading system that uses moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when short-term momentum aligns with the prevailing trend direction and manages exits through a combination of trailing stops and fixed take-profit levels. The system applies position sizing based on account equity and includes basic risk management features.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个趋势跟踪交易系统，利用移动平均线交叉和动量指标来识别并跟随市场趋势。当短期动量与主要趋势方向一致时开仓，通过移动止损和固定止盈的组合来管理出场。系统根据账户权益进行仓位管理，并包含基础的风险管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过快速和慢速移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求短期均线穿越长期均线，同时动量指标（如RSI或MACD）确认趋势强度，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。出场条件采用双重机制：固定止盈锁定利润，移动止损保护已获利润并让盈利奔跑。仓位管理基于账户净值的固定百分比计算，每笔交易的风险暴露可控。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓数量限制，防止过度交易。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在趋势反转时可能存在较大回撤风险，因为移动止损在剧烈行情中可能滑点较大。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, using crossovers between fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require the short-term MA to cross the long-term MA while momentum indicators (such as RSI or MACD) confirm trend strength, avoiding frequent entries during ranging markets. Exit conditions employ a dual mechanism: fixed take-profit to lock in gains and trailing stops to protect profits while letting winners run. Position sizing is calculated based on a fixed percentage of account equity, keeping risk exposure per trade controlled. Money management includes a maximum open position limit to prevent overtrading. The overall strategy logic is clear, but there is potential for significant drawdowns during trend reversals, as trailing stops may experience slippage in volatile market conditions.
pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，容易理解和验证
采用移动止损机制，能有效保护盈利头寸
仓位管理基于账户权益百分比，风险控制较为合理
pros_en: Trend following strategy logic is clear and easy to understand and verify
Trailing stop mechanism effectively protects profitable positions
Position sizing based on account equity percentage provides reasonable risk control
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
趋势反转时移动止损可能因滑点造成较大损失
缺少波动率和点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下表现可能不佳
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Trailing stops may cause significant losses due to slippage during trend reversals
Lacks volatility and spread filters, potentially underperforming in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易频率
加入点差过滤，避免在点差过大时开仓
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to reduce trade frequency during ranging markets
Incorporate spread filter to avoid opening positions when spread is too wide

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤机制，高点差环境下可能意外亏损
移动止损在剧烈行情中存在滑点风险
未检测新K线形成，可能在同一根K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Lacks spread filter mechanism, may incur unexpected losses in high-spread environments
Trailing stop carries slippage risk during volatile market conditions
No new bar check, potentially opening multiple positions within the same candle

The system applies position sizing based on account equity and includes basic risk management features.
